subject: {community_name} needs members — here's how top owners grow
preview_text: 5 places we've seen owners post that actually convert.
body_paragraphs: Your community {community_name} has {member_count} member{member_plural}. Owners who hit 25+ members in week one all use the same playbook — here it is.

1. WhatsApp/Telegram group chats: drop the link with a one-line tease ("AI calls for every NBA game, free to join")
2. X / Twitter: post your most confident pick of the night with the join link in the reply
3. r/nba, r/sportsbook, r/dfsports on Reddit: a pinned daily thread
4. TikTok comments under NBA preview / parlay videos
5. Discord servers for the teams you cover
Predictify makes the cover image for you (your share link looks 3x better with one — that alone moves join rate). Open the share kit, copy the link, paste it where NBA fans gather.
